# Dave Bettner

Accounting technology consultant based in Des Moines, Iowa. Financial reporting and customer delivery since 2015; roles at Workiva, Ambra Health, Citrin Cooperman, and LSL. Current title: Senior Manager at LSL.

Experience includes Workiva implementation, requirements workshops, consulting-team leadership, customer training, API and SSO integration requirements, and engagement scoping. Personal projects explore AI-assisted reporting and accounting checks using synthetic or mock data. These are not client deployments or Ramp product experience.
